input: How we can use Grok Bot (xAI always-on agents) with the ai-video-editor pipeline: an editor bot and a viewer bot that message Noodlz on his phone; set it up before tomorrow

baseline.derivedFrom: Explore agent scan 2026-11-20 + docs.x.ai/grok-bot pages (overview, faq, skills-routines-and-automations, computer-and-apps, chat-and-collaboration)
baseline.repo: ai-video-editor (api/ FastAPI backend; mcp/ sibling FastMCP stdio server)
baseline.nature: local-first video pipeline; footage never leaves the PC

claims.claim: No outbound notifier/webhook code exists in api/src; only outbound httpx.post is Groq transcription (candidates/transcribe_backends.py:231)

Job completion is written in three copied helpers (routers/analyze.py:50 _finish, routers/assets.py:439 _finish_job, routers/shorts.py:57 _finish_job) plus inline SQL in edits.py:111, league.py:43, sfx.py:45, clips.py:34-39, projects.py:88-140
highlights.build_highlights (highlights.py:317-328) and shorts.build_shorts (shorts.py:1191) return structured dicts that jobs flatten to a 'written/total -> folder' string

Panel round artifacts (brief.md, clips.json, transcript.json, *-expert.json, panel-decision.md, watch_*.json) are written by the chair session by hand into WORKSPACE/panel/<round>/; no backend code writes them

POST /api/v1/mentor/record_correction (routers/mentor.py:66) takes game, feedback, rule, clip_ref?, source_context?, tags?, concept?, verdict? (payoff|false_positive|style), example?; MCP tool lacks the typed fields
config.py is one flat pydantic-settings class; optional integrations are prefixed field blocks inert when empty (riot_* :62-80, typesafe_* :43-52, langfuse_* :113-116)
MCP server runs stdio only (mcp.run() server.py:2227); mcp[cli]>=1.27.1 supports streamable-http but no auth layer exists
viewer-expert log entry format: '- YYYY-MM-DD analytics: <platform> <video> <summary>. Lesson: ...'; analytics entries outrank web rules (SKILL.md:62-63)
Spec D22: teammate audio allowed in cuts; summoner names cropped/blurred in 9:16; logs never quote teammate speech; transcripts never committed (spec-expert-panel.md:176-182, :241)

Grok Bot: always-on cloud agents; channels = desktop/phone app, X Chat, Slack, voice; no SMS/iMessage/email-to-user; routines on schedule or events (Slack, email to bot address, inbound webhook POST URL + bearer); remote MCP by URL with headers/OAuth; skills from written instructions; bots can message each other; approvals expire ~30 min

Grok Bot connectors: no Jira/Atlassian, no GitHub connector (git via cloud computer CLI, credentials shared across bots); Google Drive read-only (search/read); all bots on an account share one cloud computer
Grok Bot included on X Subscription Premium/Super/Ultra and paid Cursor plans; usage from a weekly shared pool; free trial = 7-day credit, never auto-converts; user currently has no plan

qaLog.q: What should the texts do for you?
qaLog.a: All four: ask me for verdicts, tell me what got made, nudge me to act, quiz me to teach it. Plus: the bot should act like an engineer: tell me about blockers and learn with me.

qaLog.q: Where should the engineer bot learn project state?
qaLog.a: All sources (Jira AVE, session reports, GitHub repo, pipeline events). Reframed: Grok Bot should be a TEAM always working on the project while I'm at work without racking up tokens: a lead (senior/principal, organizes, reports to me), a pure editor, a devops engineer (hygiene, scalable, extendable, COST is huge), and a viewer-retention researcher who studies zekken, jawgemo, ryuk lol, MrBeast. My content: philosophical, funny, wide variety, montage-y, heartfelt with story.

Continuous, but worried about cost. I want a lot of work done. When the lead shows me a video I'm happy with I tell it 'go to sleep with the team' and everything stops. Jev should help with classifying so Grok Bot can always be working.

qaLog.q: How do bots get a video rendered when they can't touch the PC?
qaLog.a: Confused about edit vs render at first; after explanation chose: local runner + Drive. Also: I want to watch parts of the video; the agent should text 'watch this part, is this ok?'

qaLog.q: How often should the lead text you?
qaLog.a: All the time. I don't want to be the blocker. I reply whenever I can. I want to be the human in the loop as much as possible.

qaLog.q: What may the editor bot see (privacy of voice comms)?
qaLog.a: Expected it to see the whole footage; after explanation chose: paraphrased digest + clips on Drive opened on demand.

qaLog.q: (user) How will the editor bot see if its work is good? A reviewer bot?
qaLog.a: Proposed and accepted implicitly: local VLM critic after every render + viewer bot second opinion on hook; lead shows user on ship_it or disagreement. User later said: 'I want the reviewer + video editor to be masters of their craft'.

qaLog.q: What should devops's first week be about?
qaLog.a: Cost audit, code hygiene review, Zeri pipeline findings, the deferred list, AND an audit of our tools. It should work closely with the others. Lead = master of all parts; devops writes the best code; reviewer + editor masters of their craft; a full-fledged team.

qaLog.q: What should the viewer bot hand the team?
qaLog.a: Creator studies into the viewer log, hook/title/caption for every short, my analytics weekly. Trend watch OK but it should ask me frequently for permission first.

qaLog.q: What may devops do to the repo on its own?
qaLog.a: Branches + PRs, you or I merge. Ping me when you need me to review code, and I want summaries.

qaLog.q: Clips to the bots' Drive folder carry teammate voices and on-screen names; transcripts and .env never leave. Right line?
qaLog.a: Yes, clips as-is to a private folder.
I don't have any. Should I do the free trial? -> Free trial first.

decisionsLog.decision: Off-hours cloud crew (code, research, planning, edit decisions, reporting); the in-repo Claude panel stays the footage-time crew on the PC
decisionsLog.rationale: Footage never leaves the PC; avoids duplicating the panel

decisionsLog.decision: Four bots: Lead (generalist, reports to Noodlz), Editor, DevOps, Viewer (retention researcher + reviewer seat)
decisionsLog.rationale: User's stated team

decisionsLog.decision: Continuous loop that idles when the queue is empty; 'sleep'/'wake' commands to the lead stop/resume everything; lead pauses itself below a usage floor; evening usage report
decisionsLog.rationale: User wants continuous work but fears cost; no public per-bot-hour price exists

decisionsLog.decision: Local runner on the PC renders edit plans and uploads mp4s (and on-request ~10 s previews) to a private Google Drive folder; bots only read Drive; nothing inbound to the PC
decisionsLog.rationale: Rendering needs footage + GPU on the PC and costs no tokens; bots cannot write Drive

decisionsLog.decision: Lead texts freely (milestones, PR pings with summaries, previews, blockers); the team NEVER blocks on a reply: every question carries the default it will proceed with; late replies are applied as corrections
decisionsLog.rationale: User wants maximum human-in-the-loop without being the blocker

decisionsLog.decision: Per game: paraphrased digest (event, timestamps, panel scores, one-line paraphrase of voice moments, no names) + the individual clips on Drive, opened on demand only
decisionsLog.rationale: Privacy rule D22; watching costs usage

decisionsLog.decision: Runner runs the local VLM critic after every render and returns critique + mp4; viewer bot gives a hook second opinion; lead shows the user on ship_it or on editor/critic disagreement; no separate reviewer bot
decisionsLog.rationale: Critic exists and costs ~$0.02/min; a reviewer bot would burn usage

decisionsLog.decision: Cost audit, code hygiene review, Zeri pipeline findings (window drift, voice-only rejection, funny threshold), the deferred list, and an audit of our MCP/API tools; coordinates with the other bots
decisionsLog.rationale: User's list

decisionsLog.decision: Creator studies (zekken, jawgemo, ryuk, MrBeast) as PRs to viewer-expert/log.md; hook/title/caption/hashtags/thumbnail timestamp for every edit plan; weekly analytics entries (user grants creator logins in the bot's Vault); trend watch only after asking the user each time
decisionsLog.rationale: User's list; analytics entries outrank rules per existing skill

decisionsLog.decision: Bots push branches and open PRs with passing tests; Noodlz or the Claude session merges; every PR triggers a text with a plain-language summary
decisionsLog.rationale: Master stays safe; the runner renders from master

decisionsLog.decision: Digests strip names; raw clips (teammate audio, on-screen names) go to a private Drive folder; transcripts, the full VOD and api/.env never leave the PC
decisionsLog.rationale: Clips are the content that gets published anyway

decisionsLog.decision: Free trial first; plan chosen after two days from the lead's usage reports
decisionsLog.rationale: User has no plan; trial never auto-converts

decisionsLog.decision: Jira via Atlassian's remote MCP server added to the lead by URL; GitHub via git + fine-grained token on the shared cloud computer; Drive read-only from the bot side
decisionsLog.rationale: No Jira/GitHub connector exists; Drive write undocumented

decisionsLog.decision: A git-based queue the runner polls: bots commit edit plans, preview requests and verdict files to a dedicated queue repo/branch; PC -> bot direction is the inbound webhook (JSON) plus Drive uploads
decisionsLog.rationale: Nothing inbound to the PC; git is the one write channel bots verifiably have

decisionsLog.decision: Strict: separate tokens, allowlist validator, Viewer has no queue write; Lead always on, others on assignment; re-decide after one day
decisionsLog.rationale: Shared injectable cloud computer; trial pool

decisionsLog.decision: Only verdicts quoting Noodlz's text reach mentor; bot defaults to a deduped decisions.log
decisionsLog.rationale: Mentor is human ground truth

decisionsLog.decision: SLEEP flag in the queue pauses the runner and buffers events; one summary on wake
decisionsLog.rationale: 'sleep' must stop the PC side too

decisionsLog.decision: id, compilation_id, base_version, schema_version, author; extra=forbid; stale plans rejected with current state; timed effects refused until applied
decisionsLog.rationale: Silent drops and races

decisionsLog.decision: 5-min heartbeat; on loss the lead texts once, Editor sleeps, DevOps/Viewer continue
decisionsLog.rationale: Runner can die while user is away

decisionsLog.decision: Rough edges accepted in the trial week as long as D15-D19 exist
decisionsLog.rationale: User chose all four bots day one

decisionsLog.decision: Claude session merges low-risk PRs; big or sensitive ones pinged to Noodlz; runner moves on deploy only
decisionsLog.rationale: User must not be the blocker

decisionsLog.decision: Dedicated Google account holding only the bot folder; retention 7 days previews, renders until shipped
decisionsLog.rationale: Connector likely reads the whole Drive

decisionsLog.decision: Full write via a separate bot Atlassian user
decisionsLog.rationale: User's choice over read-only

decisionsLog.decision: All four bots, previews only; edit_plan execution and mentor verdicts follow once D15-D18 are built
decisionsLog.rationale: User's choice

redTeamFindings.title: Git queue is an inbound command channel; shared token on shared injectable cloud computer
Verdict files have no provenance; bot defaults could become Noodlz's rulings
Four always-on bots drain the 7-day trial pool
redTeamFindings.resolution: Lead always on, others on assignment, caps, re-decide after one day (D15)

redTeamFindings.title: 'sleep' stops bots but not the PC
redTeamFindings.resolution: Sleep flag pauses runner and buffers events (D17)

redTeamFindings.title: Edit plans lack envelope/version; silent drops; races with daytime panel
redTeamFindings.resolution: Envelope + base_version; stale rejected; timed effects refused (D18)

redTeamFindings.title: No heartbeat; runner death unseen
redTeamFindings.resolution: 5-min heartbeat; lead texts once; Editor sleeps (D19)

redTeamFindings.title: Every PR needs a human merge; user is the blocker
redTeamFindings.resolution: Claude merges low-risk PRs; big ones ping user; explicit deploy (D21)

redTeamFindings.title: Drive connector reads whole Drive; no upload creds/quota/retention
Atlassian OAuth from a bot; trial expiry mid-run
redTeamFindings.resolution: Separate bot Atlassian user; trial-end runbook (D23)

redTeamFindings.title: 'Before tomorrow' needs ~6 new components
redTeamFindings.resolution: All four bots, previews only on day one (D24)
